prompt: Implement the Deutsch-Jozsa circuit for the constant oracle f(x) = 0 for every 3-bit input x. Use qubits 0, 1, 2 as the input register and qubit 3 as the ancilla. Steps: initialize the ancilla (qubit 3) to |1> with an X gate, apply Hadamard to all 4 qubits, apply the oracle (for this constant-zero function, the oracle does nothing at all — no gates), then apply Hadamard to qubits 0, 1, 2 only (not the ancilla). Return the resulting 4-qubit state; no measurement.
